news.title: Sample story: enrolment for the new school year
news.summary: A sample story used to check that the news pages work. Replace or delete it once the site has real announcements.
news.content:
This is a **sample story**. It exists so the news list is not empty the first time the site is opened, and so the story page can be checked end to end.

## What to check

- the cover photo appears on the list and at the top of the story
- the tags below the title link back to the filtered list
- the body renders headings, lists and links

Delete this story in the admin once the school has real news to publish.

news.title: Sample story: an event with no gallery
news.summary: A second sample story, this one without extra photos, so the story page can be checked both ways.
news.content:
A shorter sample story. It has a cover photo but no gallery, which is the common case for a short announcement.

> A quoted line, to check that quotes render.

The site turns this Markdown into HTML itself, so the story looks the same whether it was written in the Markdown editor or stored as blocks.
